openingSource.boundary: exclusive opening slot; inclusive first fully reconciled finalized closing snapshot reaching target

entryBasis: floor(max(0, min(qualifying net buys, closing balance - opening balance)) / 100000 BULLEN)
progressBasis: sum of whole entries rounded down per wallet, multiplied by 100000 BULLEN; incomplete batches do not advance shared progress
selection: four independent entry-weighted draws with replacement
qualificationPolicy: verified-direct-bullen-endpoint-v2; paired-token quote acquisitions excluded; unknown routes pause verification
retentionPolicy: Purchase credit is bounded by net direct buying and net balance growth from opening. Incoming transfers alone earn nothing. Sales and outgoing transfers can reduce retained credit; repurchases or returned balances can restore credit only within those two bounds.
